redraws.prompt:

Match their visibly chunky square pixel clusters and strong dark stepped outlines. Draw on a low-resolution square pixel grid then upscale with nearest neighbor. A huge head, blocky torso, very short legs and broad boots, cute squat body proportions comparable to the Wizard. A few flat, warm palette ramps and large uninterrupted patches, with enough negative space to recognize the primary prop. Single full-body character centered with feet and props fully included, on genuinely transparent alpha. Keep silhouette clean. No ground, shadows, glows beyond silhouette, lettering, or frame. Use materially fewer detail marks than the third input.
Revised Artificer. Keep the friendly stocky adult dwarf, white beard, brass goggles with cyan lenses perched on forehead, a single oversized blocky steel wrench, teal coat and brown apron. Use one clearly visible cyan vial as the single workshop accent. Simplify the backpack to one silhouette and combine all belts and machinery into a small handful of broad shapes. Give the head nearly the same visual weight as the body. Three main tones per material. Large boots directly beneath short legs.
